title: How to organise the entry console or bench | Entryway
description:
Somewhere to sit while you lace a boot, and somewhere to set a bag down for thirty seconds.

This is the Entry Console or Bench in the Entryway. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Three items or fewer on the top, a seat with nothing on it at all, and a drawer where every divided section has one named category and you can see the base of the drawer between things.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Tip the drawer out onto the bench.
Straighten: Divide the drawer into named sections and hold to them: dog lead and waste bags, sun cream and insect spray, a
Shine: Take the drawer fully out and tip the sand and crumbs out of its corners.
Safety: Fix the console to the wall if it is taller than it is deep, because children climb open drawer fronts like a
Standardize: Write the three permitted top items on a card and tape it inside the drawer, so the cap survives everyone who
Sustain: When you clear the dinner table, carry the plates past the bench and take the top back down to three on the wa

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Three items on the top, an empty seat, and every drawer section holding one named category.
